policy_note: The selected HaGeZi source is Pro Mini. HaGeZi describes the Pro tier as Balanced with low-to-moderate breakage risk; this project therefore treats it as a review-focus source, not as an author-defined strict/aggressive tier. Comparison memberships are descriptive only and are not independent votes.

lineage_evidence.interpretation: The HaGeZi source catalogue lists these as build inputs; this does not mean every listed rule is copied into Pro Mini.
